user.title: New Virtual Solar setup
user.description: Give this setup a name, then pick a profile for a known kit (or Custom to fill everything in manually). You can add more setups later to compare configurations in parallel.

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: Pick the sensors that drive the simulation.

panel.title: Solar panels
panel.description: Initial values for the panel sliders. You can edit them live from the dashboard later.

abort.already_configured: A Virtual Solar setup with this name already exists. Pick a different name.

get_dashboard.name: Get dashboard YAML
get_dashboard.description: Returns a Lovelace dashboard config pre-populated with the entity IDs from your Virtual Solar setup(s). Copy the entire response and paste it into a new dashboard's Raw configuration editor. With multiple Virtual Solar setups, each becomes a view (tab) in the dashboard; pass entry_id to get just one.

entry_id.name: Setup entry ID
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of a specific Virtual Solar setup. If omitted, the returned dashboard includes one view per setup.

init.title: Sensors
init.description: Pick the sensors that drive the simulation. Panel count, panel wattage, battery capacity and system efficiency are now live, edit them from the dashboard.

battery.title: Virtual battery
battery.description: Charge and discharge limits. Battery capacity and system efficiency are live, edit them from the dashboard.
